description: Defines an internal sealed record 'AdoNetGrainDirectoryEntry' representing a grain activation in an ADONET grain directory, including methods for conversion to/from 'GrainAddress'.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectoryEntry
classes.description: Represents a grain activation in the ADONET grain directory with properties for cluster ID, provider ID, grain ID, silo address, and activation ID, along with conversion methods.

methods.name: ToGrainAddress
methods.description: Converts the entry to a GrainAddress object.

methods.name: FromGrainAddress
methods.description: Creates an AdoNetGrainDirectoryEntry from a given GrainAddress.
